page.heading: Bulk Pricing For Repair Shops & Technicians
page.intro: If you're ordering laptop parts regularly, you shouldn't pay one-off retail prices or wait behind individual buyers for stock. Modern Tech runs a dedicated trade path for technicians and businesses — volume pricing, priority stock holds and credit terms for repeat customers.

benefits.heading: Why Technicians Order From Modern Tech

items.label: Volume Pricing
items.desc: Pricing steps down as order volume goes up — ask us for a quote on your typical monthly order.

items.label: Priority Stock Holds
items.desc: Regular trade customers can hold stock ahead of a job, so a part is ready when you need it.

items.label: Credit Terms
items.desc: Established repair shops can apply for credit terms instead of paying upfront on every order.

items.label: Fast Turnaround
items.desc: Same-day Nairobi delivery keeps a repair job moving instead of stalling on a missing part.

faqs.q: How much volume do I need to qualify for bulk pricing?
faqs.a: There's no strict minimum — message us with your typical monthly order and we'll confirm pricing that makes sense for your volume.

faqs.q: Do you offer credit terms to every technician?
faqs.a: Credit terms are set up after an initial period of regular cash/M-Pesa orders, based on order history and volume.

faqs.q: Can I hold stock before a job is confirmed?
faqs.a: Yes, for established trade customers. Ask us when you set up your trade pricing.

final_cta.heading: Ready To Set Up Trade Pricing?
final_cta.copy: Message us on WhatsApp with your shop name and typical monthly order — we'll get you set up.
